content.title: Aubrey Plaza pregnant with her first baby 1 year after husband's death: report
content.text: Aubrey Plaza is reportedly pregnant with her first child. The actress, 41, is expecting a baby with her partner, actor Christopher Abbott, and is due in the fall, People reported. “It was a beautiful surprise after an emotional year,” a source told the outlet. “They feel very blessed.” Aubrey Plaza is reportedly expecting her first child with her partner, Chris Abbott. They’re pictured here in January 2020. Getty Images for Audible Plaza and Abbott are seen here with their “Black Bear” co-star Sarah Gadon at the Sundance Film Festival in January 2020. Penske Media via Getty Images Page Six reached out to Plaza’s rep for comment but didn’t receive a response. Plaza tragically mourned the death of her husband, Jeff Baena, in January 2025. The screenwriter died by suicide, according to online records from the County of Los Angeles Medical Examiner’s Office obtained by Page Six. He was 47 years old. The two, who got married in 2021, had separated four months before Baena’s death. She hid her baby bump last month at Paris fashion week in an oversized black leather coat. Getty Images Plaza mourned the death of her husband, Jeff Baena, in January 2025 after he died by suicide. They’re seen here together in July 2014. WireImage Want more celebrity and pop culture news? Start your day with Page Six Daily. Thanks for signing up! Plaza broke her silence on his death last August during her appearance on Amy Poehler’s “Good Hang” podcast. “Right in this very, very present moment, I feel happy to be with you,” she told her former “Parks and Recreation” co-star. “Overall, I’m here and I’m functioning.” Plaza noted she was “very grateful to be moving through the world” and felt “OK.” The two, pictured here in August 2014, were separated months before his death. Mark Davis In August 2025, she said her grief over Baena’s death was “always there.” They’re seen here in May 2016. Patrick McMullan via Getty Images She later candidly described her grief. “At all times, there’s, like, a giant ocean of just awfulness that’s just right there and I can see it.” She continued, “Sometimes I just want to dive into it and be in it. And sometimes I look at it and sometimes I just try to get away from it, but it’s always there.” It’s unclear when Plaza and 40-year-old Abbott’s relationship turned romantic, but they’ve worked together over the years. They co-starred in the 2023-2024 off-Broadway revival of “Danny and the Deep Blue Sea” and were also co-stars in the 2020 comedic thriller “Black Bear.”
